faq.question: Can I record YouTube videos at Birdcast?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast can support YouTube videos, video podcasts, interviews, creator episodes and educational content.

faq.question: Can one recording create long-form and short-form content?
faq.answer: Yes. Long-form recordings can often be repurposed into clips, reels and YouTube Shorts when the session is planned that way.

faq.question: Is the studio suitable for creators?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup works for creators, experts, founders, brands and companies that want a more professional YouTube look.

faq.question: Can Birdcast help with the recording setup?
faq.answer: Yes. The team handles the studio setup, cameras, microphones, lighting and production flow.

faq.question: Should YouTube projects start with WhatsApp?
faq.answer: For YouTube projects, WhatsApp is recommended so the team can understand the format, length, guests and delivery expectations.
